title: helichrysum pallasii
intro: Helichrysum pallasii, commonly known as Mountain Everlast, is a flowering plant species belonging to the daisy family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce pain, swelling, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Helichrysum pallasii include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The plant's therapeutic actions are thought to be due to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-cancer properties, making it a valuable plant for various health applications.
